answer: Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The forge decay curve is applied at each close, violet records the drop, and oasis recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 20 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
